request: New Wait for Transfer stock checks use SO placement +5 working days.
scenarios: New Special and Backorder vendor_transfer responses ignore fixed client dates and persist a relative SO placement policy.
Before a linked SO: Sales can accept, no concrete ETA or readiness reminder; SCM can confirm not ready without a date.
Successful SO link materializes ETA five Ontario working days after placement, excluding placement day, weekends and public holidays.
Automatic SO submission uses its original Toronto submission date on recovery; manual SO links use the mirrored SO transaction date. Missing source dates fall back to link date.
Placement and ETA are stable across retries and reloads; failed links change nothing.
Only new-policy active transfer lines receive dates; existing fixed ETAs and unrelated statuses remain unchanged.
Backorder checks submitted after SO link immediately calculate from saved placement date.
After placement SCM can revise readiness ETA for a delay; subsequent links do not overwrite that revision. Ready clears the ETA and reminder.
SCM hides date input for transfer stock response, shows relative label before SO; Sales displays relative label and acceptance; both show concrete ETA after placement.
Existing decline visibility, conversations, authorization and order operations remain intact.

failureModel.wrong calendar or timezone: unit and property tests including Thanksgiving, Christmas and Toronto midnight
failureModel.premature or drifting ETA: repository transaction tests, retry and failed-link assertions
failureModel.partial line updates: transaction rollback and mixed-line integration test
failureModel.legacy ETAs rewritten: migration preservation and line selection assertions
failureModel.schema rollout mismatch: isolated forward/rollback rehearsal, schema-only migration before app restart

setup.dependencies: none; reuse installed bounded Compose test image and toolchain
setup.git: preserve dirty workspace; scoped baseline and runtime hashes, no commits
setup.deployment: scoped changes over captured live image; app-only update with rollback; no live business writes
